sections.text: HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models. HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it.

Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation. Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history.
